title: LLMeter source graph
notes: Edges point from a source to the source it cites or draws data from. Level = shortest distance from the LLMeter website (level 0). 'read' is the date a page was opened; null means the node is named by its parent but was not opened. 'status' says whether a node was expanded and, if not, why.
